---
format: episode-circle
logline: A lamp keeper's daughter rows across the bay at night to bring back the lamp's last wick.
---
Wren has kept the harbour lamp since her father's hands began to shake. When the last wick burns
down on the eve of the storm, she rows to the far shore alone, trades the boat for a coil of wick,
and walks home along the cliffs in time to light the lamp for the boats still out.
